description: Routes départementales des Pyrénées-Atlantiques is a dataset listed in Data64 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département des Pyrénées-Atlantiques. Réseau routier départemental des Pyrénées-Atlantiques. Il correspond aux routes gérées par le Département. Attention, un enregistrement ne correspond pas à la totalité d'une route mais à un tronçon. Les tronçons de routes sont classés en 4 catégories: Catégorie 1: Grands itinéraires. Coverage: Pyrénées-Atlantiques. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are Route, RD, Infrastructures, Reseaux de transport, Trafic, Voirie. The portal shows 1,112 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-le64-fr-portal.
